name: Keyword tooltips
oneLiner: Rich text whose keywords (statuses, stats, terrain, rules) open a tooltip on mouse hover, touch long-press or tap and keyboard focus: icon, title, kind and text with its own keywords that open nested tooltips. Click, tap or a key pins a tooltip; placement keeps it inside the view, never over the word it explains, clear of the HUD and characters when possible; every move is a fade, glide or crossfade. Crisp bitmap fonts on pixel canvases, smooth text on HD canvases, readable on phones; the game's own font can draw the words.
notFor: clickable menu labels (a press on a keyword is taken by the module: show a description line next to the menu instead)
long scrolling documents (one tooltip text is a few sentences; very long texts are truncated when nothing fits)
games that already use Tab, T and Escape in play without remapping focusKey / pinKey

needs: the game's canvas and the coordinate space of its draw calls (view)
keyword definitions {title, kind, icon, color, text} written from the game's rules; [id] references between them
update(stepMs) in the fixed step (also the ?t= fast-forward); draw(ctx) last in every render path
rich text placed with text() / setText() where the player reads it; mark() for words or icons the game draws itself
optional uiRects() (HUD) and avoid() (unit boxes) in view units; optional game font {measure, draw, h, lineH}
provides: tooltips on hover (delay), long-press / tap (touch) and Tab focus, nested up to depth, pinning by click / tap / pin key
state(): open chain with rects, anchors and sides; lastDrawn(): panel / text / notch rects; stats(): opens, fallbacks, coverAnchor, offView, unknown, errors
onOpen / onClose / onPin callbacks; scripted control (open, openAt, pin, close, focusNext, pointer, key)
consumes only presses on keywords and tooltips, Tab, the pin key and Escape (the last two only while something is open or focused)

params.label: Pin key (a key the game does not use)

assets: none in the module: 5x7 and 3x5 bitmap fonts, 14 pixel icons with vector twins, panels, notches, pin, focus ring and long-press ring are drawn in code; keywords may pass their own icon image. The demo reuses demo-kit, pixel-kit and painted-ui icon art from this repo.
status: built 2026-11-19 (M15); module v1.2.1 after strict critic r2 (parent row on stacked tooltips, focus ring on stacked titles)
